llm_response.reason: 1) Offers abnormally low prices on high-demand electronics and luxury goods, with implausibly high volume of 'sold' units, and urgency/popularity tactics. 2) Only accepts payment in cryptocurrency (USDT/ETH/BTC), never standard business methods like credit card or PayPal. 3) Company information is ambiguous and references non-existent or spoofed entities ('TikTok-Wholesale Limited'), including false implication of relation to TikTok or Shopify. 4) The site's domain was registered only days ago, yet claims massive global reach and huge user base, which is highly suspicious. 5) WHOIS info is concealed behind privacy protection, with a registrar often used for suspicious domains. These collectively indicate a typical Fake Online Shopping scam.
